name: 81504 · Grand Jct, CO
findings: ZIP 81504 (Grand Jct) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81504 (Grand Jct) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 81504 (Grand Jct) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
